newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 11 trln lire BTP, CCTs.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 11 trln lire BTP, CCTs.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected to issue on average 11.25 trillion lire worth of fixed-rate government bonds (BTP) and floating-rate certificates (CCT) at its mid-month auction, analysts polled by Reuters said.
Estimates ranged from 9.0 to 12.5 trillion lire worth of paper to be offered at the April 15 and 16 auctions against 4.5 trillion lire worth of paper falling due.
The Treasury has announced that on April 15 it will offer a fifth tranche of March 1, 2004, 3.55 percent CCTs and an 11th tranche of February 1, 2007, 6.75 percent BTPs.
On April 16 it will offer a ninth tranche of February 15, 2000, 6.00 percent BTPs and a seventh tranche of March 1, 2002, 6.25 percent BTPs.
The Treasury said it would not be offering a 30-year BTP for auction due to technical reasons.
